title: "Caribbean pedohydrology"
description: "Soil water retention and runoff for flood modelling on an island without a soil survey, guided by uncertainty."
categories: [NDA, In progress, Water, Socio-ecological, Caribbean]

The island has never had a soil survey, yet flood models need to know how much water the soil holds and how much runs off. What makes this project different is that uncertainty propagation guides every step: the hydropedological assumptions, the models, and the decisions built on them.

![Our free hydrologic soil group tool applies the standard NRCS rules to a single soil. The project goes further, with no soil survey to start from and uncertainty carried through every step.](../images/hsg-tool-screenshot.png){fig-alt="Screenshot of the RafikiArdhi hydrologic soil group tool: soil inputs on the left, and on the right the result, group C, with the saturated conductivity estimate and the NRCS decision table."}
